Verdict Picks Toon is our comic series: one short story per buying guide, so the one fact that matters sticks. The characters and scenes are fictional; every number in a balloon comes from the guide, where its source is named.

The art is generated with Google Gemini (AI) from our scripts; the story, the lettering and the facts are ours. Not sponsored by any brand. The guides contain Amazon links, which are paid links: as an Amazon Associate we earn from qualifying purchases.

Season 1 in one video

7 minutes 48 seconds: the three stories, then the facts behind each one. Watch on YouTube for subtitles in 11 languages.
